ref_text: Hello, my little friends! Wow, look at all these beautiful colors! Can you find the red one? Yay, you did it! Now let's count together: one, two, three! Hooray, great job!
praise: [excited] Yay, you got it! [whisper] So smart!

EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.title: Colors Dance Party! 🍓 Learn Colors for Toddlers & Preschoolers
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.learning_objective: Recognize and name eight colors using everyday objects
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.intro: [excited] Wow! Hello, hello, my little friends! I'm Lumi the owl! [excited] Yay! Today we're going on a super colorful adventure! We will find eight beautiful colors, play guessing games, and dance, dance, dance! [whisper] Are you ready? [excited] Let's go!
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.mystery: [excited] Ooh! What color is coming next? [whisper] Shh... let's count together!
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.repeat: [excited] Ooh, say it with me! {K}! [excited] Louder! {K}! [whisper] Wow, you're so good!
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.review_q: [excited] Ooh! What color is this? Shout it out!
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.chant: [excited] Woo-hoo! Now let's sing all the colors together!
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.dance: [excited] Whee! Dance break! Wiggle your arms! Stomp your feet! Clap, clap, clap! [whisper] You're doing so great!
EP-COLORS-MEGA-V1.outro: [excited] Wow, wow, wow! You learned eight colors today: red, blue, yellow, green, purple, orange, pink and brown! [whisper] I'm so proud of you. Give yourself a big hug. [excited] Yay! See you next time! Bye bye!

EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.title: Silly Animal Sounds Party! 🐮 Learn Animals for Toddlers & Preschoolers
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.learning_objective: Name eight animals and the sounds they make
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.intro: [excited] Wow! Hello, hello, my little friends! I'm Lumi the owl! [excited] Yay! Today we're visiting lots of animal friends! We will learn their names, copy their silly sounds, and play guessing games! [whisper] Are you ready? [excited] Let's go!
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.mystery: [excited] Ooh! Who is hiding? [whisper] Shh... let's count together!
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.repeat: [excited] Ooh, say it with me! {K}! [excited] Louder! {K}! [whisper] Wow, you're so good!
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.review_q: [excited] Ooh! Who is this? Shout it out!
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.chant: [excited] Woo-hoo! Now let's say all our animal friends together!
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.dance: [excited] Whee! Dance break! Flap your wings like a duck! Stomp like an elephant! Hop like a bunny! [whisper] You're doing so great!
EP-ANIMALS-MEGA-V1.outro: [excited] Wow, wow, wow! You met so many animal friends today! [whisper] I'm so proud of you. Give yourself a big hug. [excited] Yay! See you next time! Bye bye!
